take: Seattle announced it activated RW/C Mackie Samoskevich from injured reserve and placed RW Jacob Melanson on injured reserve. Samoskevich has three goals in eight games, about 1.65 more than his chances would suggest, and he plays second-line minutes (15:23 a night). Melanson's absence leaves a fourth-line spot that Ben Meyers has held for the past five games. Seattle (5-3-1) has generated 45.6% of the expected goals, the share of chance quality it controls, so Samoskevich's return matters.
